notes.title: Cannon turret rework, added some enemies
notes.content:
We plan to fix the game balance change from May 17th.
This is a change to deal with the fact that the large barrel turret is currently too strong.

Cannon turret change
 - The direct damage is not changed.
 - Instead of eliminating range damage, reduce the movement speed of enemies within range for a while.

Add Air Transport Enemy
 - Regularly drop small enemies and add flying enemies that collectively drop enemies when killed.
 - The dropped enemy will explode and damage itself. (The terrain is not destroyed)

Addition of individuals with high climbing ability
 - When the number of enemies appearing from one nest is more than a certain value, the enemies of different colors with a fairly high ability to climb a cliff will appear. This may cause the enemy to attack on a new route.

tags.balance_change: - The direct damage is not changed.
- Instead of eliminating range damage, reduce the movement speed of enemies within range for a while.

tags.feature: - Regularly drop small enemies and add flying enemies that collectively drop enemies when killed.
- The dropped enemy will explode and damage itself. (The terrain is not destroyed)

- When the number of enemies appearing from one nest is more than a certain value, the enemies of different colors with a fairly high ability to climb a cliff will appear. This may cause the enemy to attack on a new route.
